race walker; died December 1978; won Barking to Southend Walk 1950 and club Long-Distance Championship; Chairman of Southern R.W.A.; judge; Metropolitan Police Chief Superintendent; M.B.E.
race walker, No 5 in 1937 dinner photo

photos.c: This photograph is part of the complete one taken at the Belgrave 50th Anniversary Dinner 1937 and shows as numbered some of the club's race walkers of that period. No 7 is Harold King (see obituary notice) others are 1. Chas Churcher, 2. Harry Churcher, 3. Joe Coleman, 4. Tommy Green, 5. Jack Bidgood and 6. Frank Elson.
